sentences.text:
Opposite Party
 Mr. A. Pradhan, Asc
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the State, on instruction, that the notice has been served on the victim/informant on 27.1.2023.
In spite of service of notice, no one appears on behalf of the victim/informant.

2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
3.

The Petitioner is an accused in C.T. Case No.114 of 2021 pending on the file of learned Ad-hoc Addl. Sessions Judge (FTSC) under POCSO Act, Baripada arising out of Baripada Town P.S. Case No.778 of 2021 for commission of the alleged offence under Sections 341/376(3)/323/506 I.P.C.
read with 6 POCSO Act.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned Ad-hoc Addl. Sessions Judge, (FTSC) under POCSO Act, Baripada by order dated 16.12.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 04.09.2021 and as charge sheet has been filed on 31.12.2021, his further continuance in custody is not warranted.
6.
Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail keeping in view the conduct of the Petitioner.

8. Considering the tenor thereof and filing of the charge sheet, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned court in seisin.
9. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
10. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rule.
